title: Alternative container runtime rejects the AWF agent container configuration
symptoms: unknown capability reported by the container runtime at start
unsupported mount reported by the container runtime at start
The agent container never starts while Squid is healthy
conditions: AWF explicitly selects an alternative OCI runtime, or the Docker daemon defaults to one; docker info alone does not prove a per-service selection
The failure happens at container create/start time, before any user command runs
rootCause: unknown - alternative runtimes implement mounts, capabilities, and seccomp differently from runc; the specific unsupported feature must be identified from the runtime error before a fix is asserted.

probe.expect: Shows daemon runtime availability/default only. Compare the explicit containerRuntime setting and selected service runtime before attributing the error; a non-runc default alone is not proof.

action: Record the selected runtime, exact create/start error and runtime version, then consult docs/gvisor-integration.md and docs/compatibility.md. gVisor uses static service DNS and proxy-only egress rather than the iptables-init path; do not infer identical behavior for Kata or microVM backends. Collect evidence rather than disabling seccomp or capabilities.
